title: 剔除科技巨头：盈利依然惊人，医疗板块为何掉队？
speaker: Kevin Gordon

segments.en: Well, even if you actually take out the big tech and the mega cap companies in earnings for second quarter earnings season, the numbers are still quite amazing. I mean, the breadth of gain so far, not just for the reporting the quarter, but for the year, the estimates for the year. That has really been, I think, a strong fundamental story for the market this year, at least in especially in the US, where, you know, breadth and revisions have been so strong across every sector.
segments.zh: 即使剔除大型科技和超大盘公司，第二季度盈利数据依然惊人。无论是本季度还是全年预期，盈利广度都非常强劲。这为今年市场提供了坚实的基本面支撑，尤其是在美国，各行业的盈利修正都非常强劲。

segments.en: Healthcare is really sort of that laggard still. But even with that, I mean, price has been pretty strong. It's been certainly, I think, a beneficiary to Anne's point about some of these areas that can really see a lot of efficiency gains. You're starting to see that trickle down a little bit. I think in terms of the broader profit backdrop and in the context of the market and performance, what's interesting is that if you go back in history, when you have earnings at this level in this zone, when they're, I mean, because we're approaching on a blended growth rate basis above 50% for just a second quarter, that tends to be consistent with weaker gains for the S&P 500.
segments.zh: 医疗保健仍是落后板块，但即便如此，价格表现也相当强劲。正如安妮提到的，一些领域能实现效率提升，这开始显现。有趣的是，从历史看，当盈利增速达到如此高水平，比如第二季度综合增速超过50%时，标普500的涨幅往往相对温和。

segments.en: It doesn't necessarily sound conventional, but when you think about a cycle getting a little bit longer, a little bit longer in the tooth, more mature, it does start to make a little bit more sense where you have more restrained gains, maybe more at the large cap level, maybe not as much at the small cap level. I think it's probably no surprise as to why the Russell 2000 has outperformed the S&P 500 over the past year. That has been a laggard in this bull market cycle. It's taken a lot more time to sort of get out of that sleepy phase. So that's why we would argue that this is still, you know, very much in keeping with what Anne said, still a relatively favorable backdrop for the broader market, not necessarily just that narrow group of mega caps.
segments.zh: 这听起来可能不太常规，但考虑到周期逐渐成熟，大盘涨幅受限，小盘股可能更有机会。罗素2000过去一年跑赢标普500并不意外，它在此前牛市中一直落后，现在才走出低迷。因此，我们认为整体市场环境依然有利，而不仅仅是少数超大盘股。
